title: Early Renewal Discount Scale — Lease Term Agreement Like-Program Renewals
content:
On a like-program renewal of a Lease Term Agreement on the Flexible, Standard, Extended or Long-Term Lease program, the early renewal discount is set by the early-renewal days counted before the expiring term's end date: 75 days or more earn 40.00 dollars a month; at least the renewing term program's early renewal window but fewer than 75 days earn that program's early renewal discount; fewer days than the window earn no discount. The early renewal discount is subtracted from the offered rent in fixing the contracted rent of the renewal; no figure is rounded before that contracted rent.

## Scale by renewing program

| Renewing term program | 75 early-renewal days or more | From the program's window to 74 days | Fewer days than the window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) — window 30 days | 40.00 a month | 15.00 a month (30 to 74 days) | none (29 days or fewer) |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) — window 45 days | 40.00 a month | 25.00 a month (45 to 74 days) | none (44 days or fewer) |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) — window 45 days | 40.00 a month | 30.00 a month (45 to 74 days) | none (44 days or fewer) |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) — window 45 days | 40.00 a month | 35.00 a month (45 to 74 days) | none (44 days or fewer) |

(The Month-to-Month Agreement and Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) programs carry a window of 0 and a discount of 0.00.)

## Early-renewal days

The early-renewal days are the calendar days by which the starting date of the count precedes the expiring term's end date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Standard Lease (10-12 Months), count taken from the handling date on which the renewal is signed)

| Early-renewal days | Discount |
|---|---|
| 75 | 40.00 |
| 74 | 25.00 |
| 45 | 25.00 |
| 44 | none |
